wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Jokku sponsor maa walla noddo kisal ɓaddu ma.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Ɗuum noon momtata keɓe ma, tawa rutta alaa.
safety.wipeConfirm: Mi faami wonde ɗuum noon momtata keɓe am.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Wasuuji ɗii anndaaka. Limle telefoŋ kollataa kasen.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Dume walli ma e ndee njaŋŋu?
reentry.celebrationAll: Njaaje cappanɗe tato e tato timmi. Mawnin yahrude ma.
reentry.crisisStep: Danndu limle ɗee jooni. Aɗa waawi tappude kadi "Need help now" dow kala ecrana.
reentry.resourceOnly: Ardorde kuule tan — Groundwork hokkataa ɗum, hawtaaki e hay goɗɗo.

steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Ndaar paapɗi yaltinde e nyalnde timmunde
steps.step10: Tabbitin nyalnde check-in arandeeri e sardiiji
steps.step13: Heɓ telefoŋ, email e internet belɗo
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step27: Naat e gollorooɓe ɓe kokkata fartaŋŋu ɗiɗaɓuru
steps.step31: Ruttin e ɓeynguure, toppto njoɓdi sukaaɓe so haani
steps.step33: Teeŋtin faandaare juutnde, mawnin balɗe ma 90

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

phase3.resumeHelp: Mah resume binndol seeɗa ummoraade e doole maa.
phase3.headline: Tiitre
phase3.interviewHelp: Huuban jaabooje. Jannginoowo maa hokkata toɓɓe e wasu wootere.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Wuro maa tan hollirete woɗɓe. Nokku tigi renndataa kasen.
phase3.rideHelp: Toroo oto. Limle telefoŋ kollataa kasen. Njokkondire e nokku ɗo yimɓe hawrata.
phase3.partnersHelp: Pelle pamɗe tati baɗɗe ndeena hakkunde mum'en.
phase3.caption: Firo foto
phase3.qaHelp: Lamndo tawa a anndaaka. Terɗe yeeso jaaboto.
phase3.merchHelp: Maale kode tan. Hay huunde yaasi faamrintaa ɗe, ñalnde alaa taƴaande.
phase3.shareHelp: Kaartal gootal wonduwal limle yahrude maa.
phase3.archiveHelp: Sokku bataake ngam hoore maa. Udditirte e nyalnde kese.
phase3.matchHelp: Agent maa yeewtidata e agent woɗɓe arande. Dating sokkaa jooni. Aɗa waawi yiide ko saabi, toroo naatnal e waɗde rematch.
phase3.override: Toroo naatnal hay e oon sahaa
phase3.datingOff: Dating sokkaa haa laawol bale ɓurɗe famɗude teeŋtina.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Ndaar ɗoo arande. So a yiɗi, tan e tolno wuro: ndaar homo faadata e kawrital maa, jokkodir e bataake app. Telefoŋ alaa, nokku tigi alaa.
phase3.groupsHelp: Pelle sellinde, ballal rutta, diina e renndo e wuro e waktu kawrital. Keɓe yeru tan — wonaa doggol tigi.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Hollirete tan so hay gooto e taƴre faadataa e kawrital maa. Yaltinta ɗaɓɓal rewaangal e app — tan e tolno wuro, telefoŋ alaa.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Oto renndo alaa ngam ndee kawrital, ko noon Miɗo haaje oto hollirete caggal.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Sofermeeɓe jaɓaaɓe tan. Pinguuji njahata gootal-gootal e passorde minut 2; a tabbitinta ko adii garoowo.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Jimɗi yeru tan. Konte streaming alaa. Pijirlooji ɗii njippata e moduleeji akademi e jannde.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Jimɗi njippii nde a woni e modulu jannde.
phase3.shareWho: Jooni: aan tan. Tagude lien accata kala mo woni lien janngude ɗum.
phase3.suggestHelp: Wasi tan — hay huunde yaltinataa haa a ɓeydi ɗum.
